newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $16.343 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $16.343 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves fell $197 million, or 1.2 percent, in the week to July 21 to $16.343 billion, according to new figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were down from $16.540 billion on July 14, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.

Since the start of the year, reserves have risen $1.16 billion, or 7.7 percent. Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion and government officials have forecast they will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
